items.text: Per-category bookmark sort — each category header has A–Z and Rec chips (click again for manual drag order). The global sort setting was removed from Config → General; legacy sortMethod migrates across all pages on first dashboard load. :sort order / az / recent applies to the focused category and shows the category name in the command palette.

Category sort UX — sort chips stay at full opacity; buttons are keyboard-focusable with ←/→ navigation; category collapse ignores clicks on sort controls; virtual blocks (Other, unknown category) get header sort controls when missing after incremental patches.
Smart collection ℹ popover — the "why am I seeing this?" hint on smart collections uses a fixed-position body popover with a readable background (replacing the unreadable CSS tooltip).

Pin & note row icons removed — pin/note toggles are gone from Config → General and bookmark rows no longer show pin/note badges. Pins still sort to the top of a category; notes stay searchable in fuzzy search and editable via :note, inline edit, and :pin / :unpin / G+P / :open pinned.
Favicon toggle + incremental render — bookmarkRenderFingerprint includes showIcons so toggling Show favicons (:favicons on/off) refreshes rows in place without a full grid rebuild.

Legacy sort migration — migrateLegacySortAllPages applies the old global sortMethod to every page's categories in one pass; transient _sortMigratedPageIds is stripped before settings persist (settings-sanitize.js).
Show favicons — Config → General → Bookmarks exposes the favicon visibility toggle with ℹ help and Playwright coverage (dashboard-show-icons.spec.js).
Playwright — dashboard-category-sort.spec.js (A–Z toggle, drag-handle hide, full-opacity sort chips); favicon toggle spec; category-sort and smart-why-popover modules.
Docs — CHANGELOG, What's new, README, MANUAL, and config help (EN/NL/DE/FR) updated for v2026.06.28.
Cache-bust — whats-new-v96 data version and 2026.06-dashboard-release-v75 dashboard release token.
